next.reason: The redefinition technique (separate VALUE-bearing entries, then a REDEFINES entry giving the table structure) is still accepted. 1985 bars VALUE in the OCCURS-repeated entries after the REDEFINES entry; 2023 'The VALUE clause shall not be specified in a data description entry that contains a REDEFINES clause or in an entry that is subordinate to an entry containing a REDEFINES clause' (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR12), applied to the table format by §2023:13.18.63.3 SR16, refuses those entries. The wider ban is not new: 1985 VI.5.15.6 GR2 already barred VALUE under any REDEFINES entry. Same requirement, compile-time in both.
